next_step: Complete 2-week POC on hosted API, then pricing term-sheet for Dedicated
notes:
Lead: VP Product (Aditi Rao) - mid-market KM product for customer support and internal knowledge. Evaluating Redwood hosted API first (fast onboarding) to validate embeddings quality + search relevance, then Dedicated for predictable throughput and nightly bulk indexing.

Key technical context / asks:
- Current infra: app on GCP, production vector store = Pinecone; experimenting with Milvus (self-hosted) for cost reasons. Wants connectors to both.
- Scale: ~12M total docs historically; active corpus ~2.3M. Daily new docs ~50k. Nightly batch reindex expected: ~1.0-1.5M vectors.
- Throughput targets: bulk upsert >= 10k vectors/min (target 20k/min) for nightly jobs; query-time QPS for semantic search ~80-120 qps; 95th tail latency target <150ms for similarity search end-to-end (embedding + ANN lookup).
- Model preferences: prefer open/Redwood-verified models; willing to test 3B/7B quantized variants for cost. Need guidance on quantization/precision tradeoffs and recommended kernel/runtime settings.
- Routing/fallback: want automatic fallback to smaller model for low-cost queries and a reliable fallback path if Dedicated pool saturated.
- Observability: token-level cost/latency breakdowns, per-index recall drift monitoring, alerting for regression on eval prompt sets.
- Security/compliance: SOC2 required, SSO/SAML + SCIM for provisioning, audit logs retained for 1 year, KMS integration mandatory, preference for data residency controls (US/EU).

POC plan (agreed on call 2026-03-02):
- Week 1: sandbox on hosted_api; ingest 100k sample docs; run similarity bench vs Pinecone baseline (recall@10, latency). Fireflies ff_2026-03-02_7341.
- Week 2: scale to 1M vectors, run bulk upsert test, measure sustained throughput and index build time; measure cost per 1M embeddings. Fireflies ff_2026-03-09_8420.
- Post-POC: Redwood to provide pricing for Dedicated reserved capacity (target commit window 12 months) and a config recommendation for batching/caching to meet cost targets.

Quote / customer language snippets captured:
- "Need to see parity or improvement vs Pinecone on recall for our support KB."
- "If Dedicated cuts our per-vector cost by 40% at scale, we can move forward."

Internal notes / sales conversation fragments:
- AE: Maya T. demo scheduled 2026-02-26 (had good engagement, product team in call).
- SE: Ethan C. to validate bulk upsert performance and provide a short script to reproduce.
- Security: exchanged initial SFR; SRE requested KMS integration docs (drive://redwood/security/answers/copperwillow-sfr).

Open questions for Redwood team:
- Exact bulk-upsert throughput we can guarantee on Dedicated vs Hosted API for 1M+ vector jobs.
- Guidance for indexing cadence (incremental vs nightly full) to minimize cost and maintain freshness.
- Does Redwood offer a native connector to Pinecone (to migrate) or recommended patterns for dual-writing during cutover?

Next immediate actions (short):
- SE to share upsert benchmarking playbook + sample script (Ethan).
- AE to schedule pricing sync for Dedicated proposals (Maya) week of 2026-03-15.
- Security: provide KMS and SAML integration docs by 2026-03-14.

Summary (one-line): Mid-market KM SaaS evaluating Redwood hosted API for embeddings & semantic search, POC progressing to Dedicated if throughput/cost targets met; primary blockers are vector-db connector performance and security/KMS signoff.
